summary: Media playback timing and shutdown behavior were improved, especially around seeking, reused streams, playback-rate changes, and audio resampling. Firefox now avoids freezing or falsely reporting underruns, preserves unplayed audio when rebasing a stream clock, and delivers media-graph messages safely during shutdown. Other changes improve AudioWorklet message passing, live-stream controls, video picture conversion, and privacy by spoofing video picture-in-picture size under Resist Fingerprinting (RFP).
